The IC approves the transaction subject to thirteen explicit conditions including EBITDA basis, NWC target, integration plan, liquidity reserve and reporting requirements.
The IC approves the transaction 4-1, with one member dissenting on the basis that concentration, integration and multiple risks were not sufficiently compensated.
The IC accepts customer concentration and integration risk as real and unresolved while nevertheless approving the deal under conditions, reflecting a contested-but-accepted institutional position.
